# Supplied fictional owner replies

These are synthetic fixture rules, not real approvals or questions asked in this demo.

## Metric

MS contribution margin for the monthly project review is (recognized fees minus posted direct production costs) / recognized fees. Exclude sales tax and unposted owner-time estimates. In October Lumen's supplied ledger supports 50% pending the cost reconciliation; cash, invoices and pipeline are different measures.

## Authority

As simulated Mosaic Studio owner, I designate Bea for commercial exceptions and client commitments, Rui for internal staffing only. Directory titles do not establish these delegations; this reply supplies our current rule. ME has its own rules.

## Commercial

I confirm Bea's supplied October 1 excerpt is accurate and authorized for Lumen's Oct–Dec managed retainer at $80/hour only. The $120 ad-hoc rate sheet remains. The retainer copy corroborates its stated contractual terms, not a blanket company rate.

## Delivery

For MS Lumen, design acceptance and launch acceptance are separate. Launch completion requires publication plus the client's acceptance after accessibility checks. Client approval of B2 is real scoped design approval, not acceptance of the final launch.

results.title: Lumen commercial scope

results.snippet:
## Context

The earlier USD 2,000 cost snapshot yielded 50%; the owner fixture says a USD 500
duplicate reversal was posted and that the earlier snapshot must be retained.[^correction]
The invoice gross of USD 4,500 includes USD 500 tax and is distinct from both
recognized fees and collection evidence.[^correction]

This is a scoped project calculation, not a complete company profitability or
cash close. Mosaic Events' Lumen row is separate. The corrected source retains
Tint's row; correcting Lumen does not revise Tint or the [[lumen-commercial]]
retainer. No agent output is relabeled human-verified.

Recommend that Bea review the commitment and decide client communication;
do not claim that review or communication already happened.[^owner]

launch acceptance after accessibility and publication are ready.[^latest-client]

amendment.[^staffing] Tint PHOTO-8 is independent and forecast November 16;
review actual staffing effects without transferring AX-7's delay to Tint.[^board][^qa]

## Definition

For Mosaic Studio Lumen in October 2026, contribution margin is recognized fees
minus posted direct production costs, divided by recognized fees. Sales tax and
unposted owner-time estimates are excluded by the supplied fictional rule.[^owner]
The corrected ledger gives USD 4,000 fees and USD 1,500 costs:
(4,000 - 1,500) / 4,000 = **62.5%**.[^ledger][^correction]
